rules: status starts at 'pending' and may ONLY become 'passing' after the verify steps were actually executed and observed to pass.
Code compiling, typechecking, or looking correct is NOT sufficient to mark 'passing'.
If a verify step cannot be run, set status 'blocked' and fill 'blocked_by'. Never guess.
'deferred' means out of scope by explicit user decision. Do not implement deferred features.
Run `node scripts/features.mjs` to see the current tally. Never hand-edit the tally.
Update this file in the same change that implements the feature, not at session end.

features.description: Next.js frontend and FastAPI backend deploy as one Vercel project via Services; /api/* reaches FastAPI with the full path; frontend TS types are generated from the Pydantic contract.
verify: `npx vercel dev -L --listen 3100` at the repo root starts both services; GET localhost:3100/api/health returns {ok:true,pandas:<version>} and GET localhost:3100/ renders the probe page showing both API responses.
In frontend/, `npm run types` regenerates src/lib/api-types.ts from the live FastAPI OpenAPI, and `npx tsc --noEmit` passes against it.
On the production deploy, GET <url>/api/health returns 200 with the pandas version and GET <url>/ shows both probes; the cold-start latency of the first /api/health call is recorded in PROGRESS.md.
features.evidence: 2026-09-12: vercel dev -L: /api/health 200 {ok,pandas 3.0.5}, POST /api/run 200, GET / 200 with probe page. npm run types regenerated api-types.ts (483 lines), tsc --noEmit clean, next build clean. Prod https://rho-cost-signal.vercel.app: first /api/health 200 in 0.23 s, warm 0.10 s; browser shows both probes (40 ms / 43 ms). Cold start recorded in PROGRESS.md.
